name: daytona
summary: I successfully created multiple Daytona sandboxes via the Python SDK—each returned a valid sandbox ID (e.g., `21a8735a-5baf-4842-9dd7-dc9ae5dc5ced`, `9e9df09f-953f-4ef2-9ca9-7bcc09e72d70`). However, executing code inside the sandbox consistently failed with `ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer` when the SDK tried to connect to the toolbox proxy at `https://proxy.app.daytona.io/toolbox`. I verified this is a network-level issue by confirming that `curl -v https://proxy.app.daytona.io/toolbox` also fails with the same connection reset, while the main API at `https://app.daytona.io/api` connects successfully. The blocker is that the sandbox-to-toolbox proxy network path is unreachable from this environment, preventing the promised outcome of running code inside the sandbox from being demonstrated.

verified.evidence: Error: Failed to execute command: ('Connection aborted.', ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer'))
